## Design

### 2026-10-05 — I started off by going to the official week one Starbie github page and getting the blender renders there for nice images. I then opened Google Slides to create a presentation about the plan of Starbi

**2h**

I started off by going to the official week one Starbie github page and getting the blender renders there for nice images. I then opened Google Slides to create a presentation about the plan of Starbie. I got the plan from the Starbie github page aswell. I used Microsoft Paint to create the simple designs and text in the presentation.

### 2026-10-06 — I made the PCB schematic and design today. I had no previous experience using KiCad so it was a difficult challenge to me.  I made the shape a star using the polygon tool. I didn't know how to make a

**3h**

I made the PCB schematic and design today. I had no previous experience using KiCad so it was a difficult challenge to me.  I made the shape a star using the polygon tool. I didn't know how to make a GND pour so I just wired all of the GND pins together to fix it.
